I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. The official date Pellucid Harbor Logistics changed hands to him was 3 November 2025, and that is the date for the CRM.

That date comes from Moss's Coastal digest of 2 November, which says ownership changes hands "tomorrow". Bettina's public cutover recap of 8 December gives the same date. The recap also says Bettina kept running the account day to day until 21 November and Kwame fully took over on 22 November. I mentioned that in the reply too.

I wrote the date in plain format for Kwame. Bettina's date-format preference only applies to her.
